title: Function Design Patterns
concept: XIOM requires all parameters to be provided — there are no default values. Use wrapper functions to provide common defaults.
why: Understanding that every parameter is required helps you design clear, predictable function interfaces.
tips: Every parameter in XIOM must be provided — no exceptions
Use wrapper functions to provide common defaults cleanly
Explicit is better than implicit — XIOM's philosophy
Good function names make the intent clear without needing defaults
common_mistakes: Assuming parameters are optional — they never are in XIOM
Creating functions with too many parameters (5+ is a code smell)
Trying to overload function names (next lesson!)
